correctness.rationale: For Cauchy(mu,sigma), sigma>0, f(x)=sigma/[pi((x-mu)^2+sigma^2)] asymptotically sigma/(pi x^2); hence |x|^r f(x) is comparable to |x|^(r-2) and E|X|^r diverges for every integer r>=1. Odd power positive and negative parts both diverge. The claimed density inverse has an unacknowledged sign: (pi sigma f(x))^{-1}-1=(x-mu)^2/sigma^2, so the displayed plus-root gives mu+|x-mu|, not x on x<mu. On the principal upper boundary complex power, the integrability strip is exactly -1<Re z<1; the upper-half-plane residue at mu+i sigma yields E[X^z]=(mu+i sigma)^z on that strip, with both endpoints divergent. The analytic continuation outside it is not an ordinary expectation. Direct tail, inversion and residue checks independently reconstruct the package proof.
